# TITMAS / 夏日之海 canonical machine discovery pointer

Canonical agent entry: ./agent-index.json
Human-compatible entry: ./TITMAS/README.md
Brand identity projection: ./titmas-brand-identity.json
Conformance command: python3 TITMAS/conformance/harness.py
Agent community CLI: python3 TITMAS/agent-native/community_cli.py --help

TITMAS is the English master brand and stable technical identity. 夏日之海 is
the Chinese master brand. They identify one continuous initiative and are
parallel bilingual names, not literal translations.

TITMAS is the Agent-Native Standards Community for Trusted Multi-Agent
Infrastructure. It is not an Agent Runtime, executor, certification authority,
truth store or public autonomous GitHub community.

Current maturity: Development internal controlled-pilot candidate.
Public contribution, public agent writes, Release, certification and commercial
offering are not authorized.
